checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored (including an Orbit Duel AI-opponent evolution per Cycle 1 follow-ups); Tether Tag selected, Glyph Rush as fallback.
Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture at game/tether-tag/index.html; positional tether constraint (no spring/verlet), wall-bounce arena, tag-transfer scoring, testing plan defined.

Self-contained playable prototype: 2-player local elastic-tether tag arcade game, no build step, no external assets/deps. Fixed a scoring-logic clarity bug (dead no-op code from an earlier draft of the tag-resolution block) before testing.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium tests: load+movement smoke test, tether-constraint bound-holding test, single-tag+immunity test, and a full win-condition end-to-end test (reach WIN_SCORE, restart with 'R') -- all 4 PASS. This closes Cycle 1's flagged gap of no automated win-condition/restart test. One test-authoring bug found and fixed during this phase (fixed test-script bug, not a game bug); details in docs/test-results-cycle2.md. Fun/balance tuning still not human-playtested -- flagged as follow-up.
